blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) directed employers to implement workplace control measures to keep employees safe from the “potential adverse effects of poor ambient air quality.” As stated in Labor Advisory No. 15, signed by Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino on Sept. 18, the order was issued as the government moves to protect workers from risks posed by smoke, haze, smog and other airborne pollutants. Employers should use the prevailing Air Quality Index Matrix and Action Points, together with the results of their Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment and Control, as the basis for determining the measures that […]...
